description: Structured summary for a research paper / clinical review.

authors.description: List of author names in order. Empty list if not found.
authors.title: Authors

publication_year.description: 4-digit publication year, or null if not found.
publication_year.title: Publication Year

study_type.description: Type of study, e.g. 'systematic review', 'randomized controlled trial', 'observational study', 'meta-analysis', 'narrative review'.
study_type.title: Study Type

interventions_studied.description: Treatments, drugs, or interventions evaluated. Empty list if none.
interventions_studied.title: Interventions Studied

sample_size.description: Total participants/patients across all groups, or null if not applicable.
sample_size.title: Sample Size

key_findings.description: 3-5 short bullet points capturing the paper's main results.
key_findings.title: Key Findings

conclusion.description: One-paragraph plain-text summary of the paper's conclusion.
conclusion.title: Conclusion

title: PaperSummary
